svg.title: ZÆTHERION · S3 island morph study
svg.desc: A resting notch widens into hover wings or deepens into an expansion. One navy silhouette, shown beside a fixture render of the FART Timers panel.
svg.text: A lit edge and a shallow lower face follow the island as it changes shape.
The panel’s inverted wedge becomes a compact app tag.
The outer shoulders stay at 84°. The inner cuts stay at 78°.
The light stays fixed as the edges move.
A SHALLOW MORPH · 1.2 s AFTER THE LAST CHANGE
A DEEPER MORPH · TOP THREE PROCESSES BY PSS
ALTERNATE · A SIGNAL SLIT IN PLACE OF THE INVERTED TAG
SYNTHETIC VALUES · TRIGGER AND PIN STILL OPEN
SAME 420 × 36 SHAPE WITH A PROPOSED GAP
THE TRAPEZOID MEETS THE LOWER EDGE
NO PLAYER OR BATTERY · CLOCK STAYS CENTRED
Still at rest. Sample readings and timings in the motion study are for review.
